content:
We keep saying everything is going digital.

Insurance is probably the best reminder that some things still come down to one very old-school thing:

Distribution.

For a lot of India, insurance is still bought through someone you know, someone who explains the policy, 

answers your questions and helps when you actually need to make a claim.

You can have the best product, the best app and the best marketing.

But if you can't reach the customer, none of it matters.

That's what makes the InsuranceDekho × RenewBuy merger interesting.

Together, they bring over 6 lakh plus digital partners and reach across 98.57% of India's pin codes.

Not the flashiest part of the announcement but probably the most important one.

Two companies most people probably haven't heard much about.

Yet, together, they have built this kind of scale.

Makes you wonder how many “big” Indian businesses we don't even know about.

Ankit Agrawal Indraneel Chatterjee Ish Babbar Balachander Sekhar
comment: The real test after achieving distribution scale will be maintaining advisor quality and customer trust. In insurance, the last-mile relationship is often where retention, renewals and claim experiences are truly won or lost.
